canhub.title: CanHub *365*
canhub.subtitle: The portal Canadian accounting firms *use for filing season*
canhub.text: After years of building client portals for Canadian practices one at a time, we built our own. Clients upload against a checklist, your team codes with OCR-suggested GIFI codes and files step by step — with payroll, invoices, deadlines, and secure chat in the same place, under your firm's branding. Perfect for modern firms looking for advanced accounting and LMS software and efficient tax tracking.
